reason: I've got more work than I can handle and I'm not going to sit through a lunch demo. Honestly the homeowner would have to be on board with it, and I wouldn't be the one paying for it anyway.

would_change_my_mind: If the homeowner or architect agreed to pay for it, and it showed up done with no work from me, I'd pass it along.
